node_definition.done_when: Done when. A test runs a stub reviewer that stores its record only after a delay, reads no review-self request until the record exists, and then reads the review promoted. A second test drains a request whose record is absent while its reviewer is live: it reads the request still waiting and the run's pointer unchanged, and a request queued behind it is promoted. A third test ends the reviewer without a record and reads the request refused with the missing record named. A negative control that writes the request at the reviewer's first progress event refuses the review in the first test. The gate runs on all_debug and its log is written to the section's evidence fragment.
